north_star: Build a falsifiable 2026 territorial probabilistic forecast, then test whether agentic collection/reasoning adds predictive information beyond a correctly specified conventional baseline.
sequence_correction: The agentic residual experiment had been pursued before the conventional baseline was fully adequate for party-level probabilistic calibration. E_reason promotion remains suspended until a stronger conventional F1 is specified and frozen.

frozen_party_calibration_gates.rule: Every one of the nine frozen party buckets must clear both floors in both historical crossfit folds.

historical_crossfit_program.important_independence_note: The 92 territories are not 92 independent observations of the election-level national regime. The historical core contains only two modern election-to-election transitions for national regime learning.

falsified_simple_repairs.falsified_claim: F0 is mainly fixable by a common national shock along the observed training direction plus wider territorial residuals.
The binding defect is only lack of full-support national covariance or party-marginal variance shrinkage.
The binding defect is only that territorial deviations need stable mean reversion instead of unit persistence.

national_regime_oracle_diagnostic.interpretation: National party state is important in some regimes, especially 2016->2021, but is not sufficient: applying the exact held-out national swing uniformly worsens 2011->2016. The missing conventional structure is therefore an interaction between election-level party regime and its territorial localization, not a scalar national swing alone.

terminal_scientific_verdict.statement: The 2011/2016/2021 legislative core alone does not identify a sharp, party-calibrated joint national-by-territorial regime model under the frozen gates. Continuing to tune increasingly flexible models on these same two macro transitions would create a material overfitting risk.
what_is_not_concluded: Territorial information has no predictive value.
National state alone solves the forecast.

priority_1_more_independent_regime_suppo: Audit 2007 party continuity and use it only for admissible national-regime prior support under an explicit protocol.
Keep 2002 quarantined/sensitivity-only unless its documented incompleteness and party-continuity problems are resolved under a new protocol.
priority_2_contemporaneous_2026_national: Collect fixed-rule, timestamped pre-election national indicators that can inform the 2026 party vector without using outcomes: credible surveys/polls if available, nationwide party-support signals, leadership/coalition/list-system events and other preregistered national covariates.
Treat these as conventional inputs before any agentic residual experiment.
required_next_information_before_F1_V4.priority_3_joint_national_territorial_mo: Condition territorial party distributions on a sampled national party vector and learn historical territorial localization/shrinkage, rather than applying a uniform national swing or tuning local residuals independently.
required_next_information_before_F1_V4.priority_4_2026_ballot_support: Replace the 2021 eligible-list support in a new immutable snapshot only when admissible 2026 roster/list evidence is sufficiently verified; candidate/list delta comes after the national-by-territorial conventional baseline.
required_next_information_before_F1_V4.agentic_gate: Do not reopen E_reason for promotion until the conventional F1 baseline passes its own frozen calibration/sharpness gates or a new protocol explicitly documents why a different proper scoring contract is required.
